[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Nozzo Naytaan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Red Nine standing by.|Nozzo Naytaan.|audio=RedSquadronRollCall.flac|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:Red_9_Naytaan.jpg|thumb|250px|Naytaan flying as Red Nine]]
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Naytaan deserted his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] after being ordered to bombard civilian targets on [[Pulassas Minor]]. Joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], he led the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces']] [[Relief of Clak'dor VII|relief effort]] to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]], before being assigned to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]. A dazzingly skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], he became an [[Ace/Legends|ace]] in only two missions, and was considered by [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] to be the squadron's most promising pilot. However, it was feared that Naytaan's career would be cut short by his excessive recklessness, a trait that his friend and squadmate [[Theron Nett/Legends|Theron Nett]] worked to curb.<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="CCGLN">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Naytaan}}</ref>

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Naytaan had attained the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. He flew as [[Red Nine/Legends|Red Nine]] in the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], during which he witnessed Dreis' unsuccessful attack run on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], erroneously observing that the squadron leader had hit the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]], before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action.<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
During the relief effort to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] and the Battle of Yavin, Naytaan flew a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] modified to have extra cargo room.<ref name="CCGR9">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Red 9}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Naytaan as pictured in the ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' is portrayed by actor Jack Klaff. The film's credits actually list Klaff as the character [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D]], so the CCG creators made an error in naming him Naytaan. The character John D has since been given the last name "Branon". According to [[Leland Chee]], Klaff's character is still considered to be John D., with Naytaan being a different pilot. Furthermore, Chee also confirmed the "It's a hit!" line spoken after Red Leader fires his proton torpedoes was credited to Naytaan.<ref name="LelandCheenNaytaan">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1695#17083464|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2008-01-10|time=3:09 PM}}</ref>
